column7: Creating a user with a role or project assignments, validating a role grant, creating an environment, copying environment secrets or inviting a member while the role/project/environment read fails returns ErrStorageReadUnavailable (503 / Unavailable), not "unknown role" / "project not found"; an absent parent keeps its text (also TestStorageReadClass_OwnRevoke, TestStorageReadClass_ApproveSecretAccessRequest, TestStorageReadClass_GrantPaths_InviteAndApprove; router-level lease routes: TestDynamicSecretLeaseRoutes_ReadFaultIs503ForGlobalHolders in ./server/http)
